description_en: Queries the regions where assets reside
name: ListRegions

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response description. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to filter regions by assets that have audit enabled. A value of true indicates that audit is enabled. A value of false indicates that audit is not enabled. If you do not specify this parameter, this filter condition is not applied
parameters.help_zh: 是否按已开启审计的资产筛选地域。true 表示已开启，false 表示未开启；不传则不使用此条件
parameters.name: audited

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to filter regions by assets that have detection enabled. A value of true indicates that detection is enabled. A value of false indicates that detection is not enabled. If you do not specify this parameter, this filter condition is not applied
parameters.help_zh: 是否按已开启识别的资产筛选地域。true 表示已开启，false 表示未开启；不传则不使用此条件
parameters.name: identified

RegionList.description_en: The list of regions where assets reside

RegionId.description_en: The region ID where the assets reside

RegionName.description_en: The name of the region where the assets reside

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to locate this API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用
